agent_changes.description: Jumping with High Gear active no longer provides any speed bonus while Neon is airborne. Instead, Neon’s air speed while sprinting will match melee speed.
Improved VFX to more clearly communicate the direction and origin of her slide
Fuel will only regenerate with a kill when Neon's ultimate is active

weapon_changes.description: All shotguns are now less accurate when moving
Run, walk, crouch-walk, and jump accuracy has been standardized across all shotguns
Crouching now provides a 15% accuracy multiplier for shotguns, matching rifles
Shotgun accuracy reduced while on a rope
Bucky pellet damage in the 0-8m range decreased
Note: this will only apply to PC for now- this spread change will apply to console in Patch 12.11

competitive_changes: We’re testing MMR changes for modes other than Competitive, Unrated, and Swiftplay. These changes should result in better, more consistent matches. We’ll use what we learn to improve Competitive, Unrated, and Swiftplay in the future.
performance_changes: Added support for AMD Anti-Lag 2, which reduces input latency in certain GPU-bound scenarios. In order to use AMD Anti-Lag 2, you need compatible hardware, with updated drivers from March 9th, 2026 or later.
